Title: Health-related quality of life and sagittal balance at two to 25 years after posterior transfixation for high-grade dysplastic spondylolisthesis
Abstract: The standard surgical technique was an all-posterior, partial reduction, and S1 to L5 transfixation <m>screw</m> technique without direct decompression. Parameters for segmental (slip percentage, Dubousset's <m>lumbosacral</m> angle) and regional alignment (pelvic tilt, <m>sacral</m> slope, L5 incidence, lumbar lordosis, and @DISEASE_Kyphosis @DISEASE_MESH:D007738 @@@thoracic kyphosis@@@) and global balance (T1 spino-pelvic inclination) were measured.
